label: Veteran's Pension, single, living alone, before tax (fortnightly)
context: Paid fortnightly to a single person who lives alone or with a dependent child. Rates rise each year on 1 April in line with changes in the average wage.

label: Veteran's Pension, single, sharing a home, before tax (fortnightly)
context: Paid fortnightly to a single person who lives with someone aged 18 or older (unless they are a dependent child of 18), or with a visitor staying more than 13 weeks in any 26 week period.

label: Veteran's Pension, with a partner, before tax (fortnightly)
context: The rate when both partners meet the criteria for Veteran's Pension is paid to each of them. It is also the rate if only one of the two meets the criteria.

label: Age to get Veteran's Pension
context: A person must also have served in the New Zealand Armed Forces on Qualifying Operational Service, meet the citizenship or residence test, be ordinarily resident when they apply, and have lived in New Zealand for the required years.

label: Income allowed each week before payments are affected
context: The most the person and their partner can earn together, before tax, each week before other income affects the payment. It applies to those the other income rules cover.

label: Weekly income where the higher reduction starts
context: For someone under 65 whom the other income rules cover, income above the allowed amount and up to this amount reduces the payment by 30 cents for each dollar. Income above it reduces the payment by 70 cents for each dollar.

label: Payment reduction between the allowed amount and the next limit
context: The reduction for each dollar of weekly income, before tax, between the allowed amount and the next weekly limit. It applies to someone under 65 whom the other income rules cover.

label: Payment reduction above the top weekly limit
context: The reduction for each dollar of weekly income, before tax, above the top weekly limit. For someone 65 or older with a partner included in the payment, it applies to income above the allowed amount.
